fixed_definition.current: Exact raw sensor/message, weekday/hour/15-minute bin; original support/class/day/recurrence/contrast/log(80)/state/write/quality gates unchanged.
fixed_definition.positive: First observed eligible binary notification in delay window; raw sensor name lowercased starts with kitchen and raw message equals ON. Other observed eligible notifications are negative, absent results are not negatives. Binary messages exactly ON/OFF/OPEN/CLOSE/CLOSED. No room renaming, power thresholding, bit-to-ON conversion, occupancy or clinical-target substitution, packet-history expansion/backdating, artificial duplication or extra households.
